body:
## Summary

Import the complete Victorian policy and research corpus from the public Sanity JSON API, with an evidence matrix mapping each adopted policy to its evidence base and a prioritised gap register.

## What changed

- **`vic/corpus/`**: Raw API snapshots of 41 adopted policies and 25 research resources, with retrieval timestamps, SHA-256 hashes and a reconciliation manifest
- **`vic/evidence-matrix.md`**: Maps each policy to its stated evidence, linked research resources and an initial evidence-strength assessment
- **`vic/gap-register.md`**: Identifies 18 policies without linked research, evidence quality observations, 10 unaddressed policy areas and 5 cross-cutting research needs
- **`vic/README.md`**: Updated to link the new resources

## Reconciliation

| Metric | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Policies in API export | 41 |
| Policies imported to manifest | 41 |
| Research resources in API export | 25 |
| Research imported to manifest | 25 |
| Broken cross-references | 0 |
| Items excluded | 0 |

All source items reconcile to their imported location or an explicit exception.

## Key findings

- 23 of 41 policies have linked research; 18 do not
- 3 research resources are not linked from any policy
- No health, education or environment/energy policy exists despite these being the three largest areas of Victorian state expenditure
- Most policies describe costs qualitatively; no quantified fiscal impact modelling is referenced

## Notes

- The issue description URLs use `/API/` (uppercase) but the server is case-sensitive; lowercase `/api/` is required
- All content is already publicly available on vic.fusionparty.org.au
- This is a bounded initial assessment, not exhaustive research
- Evidence-strength ratings are heuristic and should be reviewed by a human

commits.messageBody:
Retrieve 41 adopted policies and 25 research resources from the
public Sanity JSON API (vic.fusionparty.org.au/api/).

Deliverables:
- vic/corpus/: raw API snapshots with retrieval log and SHA-256 hashes
- vic/corpus/MANIFEST.md: reconciles every source item (41 + 25 = 66)
- vic/evidence-matrix.md: maps each policy to its evidence base
- vic/gap-register.md: prioritised research gaps and missing policy areas
- vic/README.md: updated to link new resources

All source items reconcile. No items excluded. 23 of 41 policies have
linked research resources. 3 of 25 research resources are not linked
from any policy. No broken cross-references found.

Note: The authorised URLs use /API/ (uppercase) but the server treats
paths as case-sensitive; only lowercase /api/ returns HTTP 200.
